records.title: MASTER: A Multi-Agent System with LLM Specialized MCTS
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.14304. Primary abstract describes MCTS-based multi-agent planning and task accuracy; it does not study inference efficiency.

records.title: TACO-RL: Task Aware Prompt Compression Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The demonstrated gain is primarily task quality at similar compression and latency, so an inference-efficiency advantage is not established.

records.title: BBS: Bi-Directional Bit-Level Sparsity for Deep Learning Acceleration
records.reason: Relevant hardware efficiency mechanism, but the evaluated workloads and bit-serial hardware setting do not establish applicability to current LLM inference/serving.

records.title: LongRecipe: Recipe for Efficient Long Context Generalization in Large Language Models
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.00509. Primary abstract concerns long-context generalization training, not inference or serving optimization.

records.title: Stress-Testing Long-Context Language Models with Lifelong ICL and Task Haystack
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.16695. Primary abstract presents a long-context stress-test benchmark; it does not propose an efficiency method.
